Root.onOpenChange.semantic: reason union adds 'swipe' and 'close-watcher' to the Dialog set: trigger-press|outside-press|escape-key|close-watcher|close-press|focus-out|imperative-action|swipe|none

Root.snapPoints.semantic: 0..1 = fraction of viewport height, >1 = pixels, strings in px/rem

SwipeArea.swipeDirection.semantic: direction that OPENS the drawer; defaults to the opposite of Root.swipeDirection

Indent / IndentBackground.semantic: state.active = any drawer inside the nearest Drawer.Provider is open (data-active)

VirtualKeyboardProvider.semantic: 1.8: keyboard-aware focus/scroll handling for bottom-sheet drawers with form fields

dataAttributes: Backdrop: data-open, data-closed, data-starting-style, data-ending-style; CSS var --drawer-swipe-progress

Popup: data-open, data-closed, data-starting-style, data-ending-style, data-expanded, data-nested-drawer-open, data-nested-drawer-swiping, data-swipe-direction ('up'|'down'|'left'|'right'), data-swipe-dismiss, data-swiping; CSS vars --drawer-frontmost-height, --drawer-height, --drawer-snap-point-offset, --drawer-swipe-movement-x, --drawer-swipe-movement-y, --drawer-swipe-strength, --nested-drawers
SwipeArea: data-open, data-closed, data-disabled, data-swipe-direction, data-swiping
Viewport: data-open, data-closed, data-nested, data-starting-style, data-ending-style; CSS var --drawer-keyboard-inset
Trigger / Close / Title / Description: same as Dialog counterparts (Trigger: data-popup-open, data-disabled)
renderProp: Per-part `render` (ReactElement | (props, state) => ReactElement) via useRender; state drives data-* attributes.
controlled: open/defaultOpen + triggerId/defaultTriggerId + onOpenChange(open, eventDetails) [reasons include 'swipe' and 'close-watcher']; snap point is its own controlled pair snapPoint/defaultSnapPoint + onSnapPointChange; actionsRef { unmount, close }; Drawer.createHandle() (open/openWithPayload/close/isOpen).
formIntegration: None from the primitive itself (no hidden inputs); the only form-adjacent feature is Drawer.VirtualKeyboardProvider, which adjusts focus/scroll for bottom sheets containing form fields and exposes --drawer-keyboard-inset on Viewport.
keyboard: Escape closes (topmost only); on Android/Chromium the hardware back gesture is wired through a CloseWatcher (DrawerRoot.mjs explicitly keeps this Android-only to avoid interfering with Escape/nesting on desktop); focus trapped when modal; swipe is gesture-only. No arrow-key navigation.
notableDifferences: Drawer extends Dialog (docs: 'Drawer extends Dialog') — it reuses Dialog's modal/focus/escape semantics and adds swipe, snap points and indent effects; a slide-in panel without gestures should just be Dialog.
onOpenChange reasons add 'swipe' and 'close-watcher' beyond the Dialog set.
Snap-point state is a second controlled axis (snapPoint/onSnapPointChange) with no React Aria analogue.
Gesture vocabulary is data-swiping / data-swipe-direction / data-swipe-dismiss plus --drawer-swipe-strength used to scale exit-transition duration.
Global indent effects require a Drawer.Provider ancestor and the IndentBackground + Indent parts (data-active).
Drawer.VirtualKeyboardProvider (new in 1.8) is required for keyboard-aware bottom sheets with form fields.
Dismissal is not disabled by a boolean prop; use onOpenChange eventDetails.cancel().
